moves.name: The Curtain Rises!
moves.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1. When the user’s Defense is raised, raises the user’s Sp. Def by the same amount. Applies the Gradual Healing effect to the user. If the user’s Diancie has Mega Evolved, also grants all of the following effects: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1. Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks.

moves.name: Noble Beauty Diamond Storm
